name: Sex Gods
source:
This video game, is about the story of an ordinary guy (Rex) who fortunately destiny establishes connection with a sex god (Seksdeus) and with the help of an ally (Cloy) will gradually become a god of sex.

Prove to Seksdeus that you are worthy to be a sex god by corrupting girls, creating new sexual monsters and all this while you take care of your girlfriend!

[From [url=https://guapoman.itch.io/sex-gods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
该游戏讲述了一个普通人（雷克斯饰）幸运地与性神（塞克斯德乌斯饰）建立了联系，并在盟友（克洛伊饰）的帮助下逐渐成为性神的故事。

通过腐蚀女孩、创造新的性怪物以及所有这一切，同时照顾你的女朋友，向Seksdeus证明你值得成为性神！

[来自[url=https://guapoman.itch.io/sex-gods]itch.io[/url]]
